title: Research: bound late retained-total mixing by its paid COPY frames
body:
The nine frozen PR589 totals occupy distinct rank-seven frames. Under the fixed late-mixing contract with no extra COPY and no frame descent, every nonempty in-place XOR network raises COPY mass from 63 to at least 65. The proof is corroborated by all 511 support joins, an independent rational oracle for 36 pairs, and arbitrary-dirty scatter controls.

Validation: Python 3.12 registered replay with source pins and scoped controls; selected-result integrity or baseline bindings and diff checks pass. See the [reproduction instructions, exact sources and remaining questions](https://github.com/woklerx/integer-mult-bounds/blob/3aa21c1e1bfecbc60fd60bf1294f6ddd29a49708/research/bit-retained-total-mixing/README.md). No selected source, certificate or kappa changes; no full selected circuit replay is claimed. Prepared by woklerx with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, with predecessor attribution retained.
